thread:
fiona: Quick proposal  run a 4-week "uptake pilot" with 5 design partners to validate onboarding friction, feedback velocity, and whether partners keep the integration live post-pilot. Recruiting: prod traffic, a dev contact, willingness to run one synthetic shape.

omar: Success criteria: either (A) partner keeps feature routed to prod for >=4 weeks after pilot OR (B) measurable product outcome (eg. 10% lift in a tracked metric) plus no quality regressions. Also require >=2 actioned items per partner from feedback.

lia: Feedback capture: structured mid-pilot form (prompt_id, rating 1-5, short note, real vs synthetic) + short 30m wrap session. We should auto-sync form results to the partner dashboard.

kevin: Ops note: reserveable_slots=2 for pilot work. Reserving gives isolation; cost estimate in the one-pager. Also need one on-call window (90m/week) for triage during weeks 1-2.

recruiter-amy: Outreach DM draft:

"Hi <name>,
Were running a 4-week pilot to improve onboarding and adoption for Redwood Inference integrations. We provide a shared dashboard and light ops support. Interested? Reply with avg req/s and a dev contact.
Thanks, Amy"

ops-bot: capacity-check: available_slots=2, est_cost_per_slot=$4200/mo. To allocate, run `/reserve slots=1 tag=uptake-pilot`.
